Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::Parse", "line": 20, "var": "version", "code": "if (!table.ReadU32(&this->version))", "note": "Reads the SILF table version from attacker-controlled font data. The version is 0x00050001, so version>>16 == 5, enabling the LZ4 compression path."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::Parse", "line": 27, "var": "compHead", "code": "if (this->version >> 16 >= 3 && !table.ReadU32(&this->compHead))", "note": "Reads compHead from attacker-controlled data. compHead=0x0807c424 has scheme=1 (LZ4) and FULL_SIZE=508964."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::Parse", "line": 39, "var": "decompressed_size", "code": "size_t decompressed_size = this->compHead & FULL_SIZE;", "note": "Extracts decompressed_size=508964 from compHead FULL_SIZE bits. This is the target output size for LZ4 decompression."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::Parse", "line": 52, "var": "decompressed", "code": "std::unique_ptr<uint8_t> decompressed(new uint8_t[decompressed_size]);", "note": "Allocates a 508964-byte buffer with new uint8_t[], which does NOT zero-initialize the memory. The buffer contains uninitialized heap data."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::Parse", "line": 53, "var": "ret", "code": "int ret = LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(...)", "note": "Calls LZ4_decompress_safe_partial with the compressed data. LZ4 returns decompressed_size (508964) but does not fully initialize the output buffer, leaving some bytes uninitialized."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::Parse", "line": 59, "var": "ret", "code": "if (ret < 0 || unsigned(ret) != decompressed_size)", "note": "The check passes because LZ4 returns exactly decompressed_size, even though not all output bytes were written. The partially-initialized buffer is accepted."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::Parse", "line": 62, "var": "decompressed.get()", "code": "return this->Parse(decompressed.get(), decompressed_size, true);", "note": "Recursively parses the decompressed buffer, which contains uninitialized bytes that will be read as SILF table data."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::SILSub::ParsePart", "line": 130, "var": "maxGlyphID", "code": "if (!table.ReadU16(&this->maxGlyphID))", "note": "Reads a U16 value from the decompressed buffer. If this read lands on uninitialized bytes from the LZ4 decompression, the value is uninitialized."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::SILSub::ParsePart", "line": 289, "var": "numPseudo", "code": "if (!table.ReadU16(&this->numPseudo))", "note": "Reads numPseudo from the decompressed buffer. This value may be uninitialized and controls the number of pMaps to parse."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/silf.cc", "function": "OpenTypeSILF::SILSub::SILPass::ParsePart", "line": 642, "var": "numRules", "code": "if (!table.ReadU16(&this->numRules))", "note": "Reads numRules from the decompressed buffer via Buffer::ReadU16. This is the memory-safety sink where the uninitialized value is read, triggering the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value crash."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace file created"
